Question: Is Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms LLC the right contractor to handle a primary suite addition for my home?

Answer: Yes, Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms LLC is well-equipped to handle primary suite additions for homeowners across Brandon, Tampa, Riverview, and surrounding communities. Expanding a home with an attached master bedroom and private bath is not a simple cosmetic update; it requires coordinating structural framing, foundation work, exterior roofline integration, plumbing, electrical, and drywall finishing into one cohesive environment. 

Our team brings more than eighteen years of trade experience, working directly with clients from initial concept discussions through the final punch list. Because we specialize in both whole-home additions and high-end bathroom renovations—including custom tile, walk-in showers, and layout reconfigurations—we manage the bedroom wing and the luxury en-suite bath under one unified team. We are insured, bonded, provide workers' compensation coverage, and offer veteran discounts.

Questions to Ask Before You Decide:
Before breaking ground on an addition, ask your contractor who manages the architectural plans, engineering approvals, and building permits. You should also confirm how site inspections are handled and how the new roof and siding will blend with your existing structure.

When you are ready to expand your living space without the stress of moving, contact Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms LLC at 813-362-0114 or visit baycityremodeling.com to schedule your free-quote consultation.
